title: Pork and greens soba
summary: Pork and greens soba is a japanese dinner built around pork fillet and buckwheat noodles, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice pork fillet and buckwheat noodles before the pan is hot. Pork and greens soba is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry pork fillet until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add buckwheat noodles and pak choi, return pork fillet, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Pork and greens soba before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the noodles, simmered in salted water until tender.
